properties.name: Egypt
properties.note: Major continuous power throughout the biblical narrative; not given a fade window.

properties.name: Israel
properties.note: Covers united kingdom (1047-930 BC) and northern kingdom (930-722 BC); see kingdoms.geojson for boundary changes at the split.

properties.name: Judah
properties.note: Southern kingdom after the split from Israel; ends with the fall of Jerusalem to Babylon.

properties.name: Philistia
properties.note: Distinct culture from the Late Bronze Age collapse to disappearance after Babylonian conquest (604/603 BC).

properties.name: Phoenicia
properties.note: City-state independence (Tyre, Sidon) ending with Alexander's conquest.

properties.name: Aram
properties.note: Aram-Damascus, ending with Assyrian conquest (2 Kings 16:9).

properties.name: Ammon
properties.note: Kingdom of Ammon, ending with Alexander's conquest.

properties.name: Moab
properties.note: Kingdom of Moab's attested independent span.

properties.name: Edom
properties.note: Kingdom of Edom, ending with Babylonian conquest under Nabonidus.

properties.name: Assyria
properties.note: Neo-Assyrian Empire; Nineveh fell 612 BC, final collapse 609 BC.

properties.name: Babylon
properties.note: Neo-Babylonian Empire, Nabopolassar to the fall to Cyrus of Persia.

properties.name: Persia
properties.note: Achaemenid Empire, Cyrus the Great to Alexander's conquest.
